hash_method: SHA256; CRLF normalized to LF for declared text extensions, raw binary otherwise
limits: Compare only the same cohort and scoring contract; model identity is contributor-declared, not provider-attested.
Each replicate pools counts over its cases; summary reports mean/range/stdev over replicates, not a significance test or winner.
Missing/failed attempted answers score empty; unattempted cases remain visible and create different comparison cohorts.
Public keys and retrospective registration do not establish blindness. Synthetic controls and corrected/development results are separate.

Batch totals compare the tool report with a publisher-logged running cumulative that is the sum of the same logged feeds: the score checks integration semantics, units, coverage and window handling, not measurement accuracy, transcription or plant truth.
registration: Industrial-yeast depth task (docs/DEPTH_GOAL.md, attempt A418): development batches B01-B05; sealed held-out batches B06-B10 scored once after the method and scorer were committed. Held-out exposure: Held-out key counts were surveyed on 2026-11-12 (row and logged-cumulative counts over all batches and the completeness tier of every batch; key values were read for B01 only); no method was run. Deterministic tool runs; the key is the sum of the same logged feeds, so this checks integration semantics, units, coverage and windows, not measurement accuracy.
